text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Thanks for your hard work today!
Thank you very much, gansu—I mean, thank you very much!
choice_data_list: Good work! You worked hard today too!
Good work! You worked hard today too!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hehe...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(I wonder if I've grown a bit...? 
My race times have gotten faster, and my standard Japanese feels pretty natural now.)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(It'd be mighty nice if I'm gettin' closer
to bein' a "city girl"... hehehe.)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(Still, back when I started, I didn't know a lick about anything
and caused Trainer so much trouble...)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Next up is tire pullin'! See you later, excuse me!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(I used to think runnin' with weights on was all it took to get stronger.
So, if it weren't for Trainer—)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
They look pretty busy workin' right now, so maybe I should give it during the break...
Wait, what's that? "For Yukino Bijin"...?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(If Trainer hadn't put together a custom trainin' plan
just for me, even now I'd probably still be...)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(Mmh... Lookin' back on it all,
Trainer's done nothin' but help me out every step of the way.)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: (I gave 'em some snacks before, but I really wanna give 'em a proper thank-you...!)

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text: I see, so that's what's been on your mind~?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... If possible, I wanna show 'em how much closer I've gotten to bein' a "city girl"
and say thanks that way...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
T' me, that's like proof I'm growin'...
An' if it made ya happy... that makes me awful glad too.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa. You really care about your Trainer, don'tcha, Yukino?
You're practically head over heels! If you two're that close—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Wh-Whoa there?! Wh-Wh-What's the matter, ya ask?!
I-I'm feelin' right as rain, honest!

...Yukino Bijin has been acting strange for a while now.
She's fidgety and looks like she wants to say something, only to shrink back.

Is it a question about training... or could it be
that she's unsatisfied with something?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? No, no, no way!
Troubled? Nothin' like that... nothin' at all...
choice_data_list: Is there something you want to tell me, then?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: S-Somethin' I wanna tell ya...?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: (...Yeah, there is! There sure is, but...)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(I can't say it~! Not somethin' like that... so easily...
Aagh, my heart's goin' pitter-patter like crazy~!)
Her face bright red, Yukino Bijin restlessly paces around the room.

Is it really that hard to bring up?
It might be best not to press her. For now—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Nghhh...!
choice_data_list: If there's anything I can do, just let me know anytime.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
choice_data_list: No rush. Let's work through it one step at a time.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(After all ya've done fer me already,
ya're tryin' to do even more fer my sake...?!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(No way... that won't do!! I gotta properly thank 'em...
No matter how embarrassin' it is, I gotta ask Trainer...)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: (Out on a date!!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...Hngh. Trainer!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Urgh...!! ...I-I'll tell ya next time!!
Please just... hold your horses a little longeeeer!!!!!

...Is it really that difficult to say?
I brace myself and decide to wait until she's ready to tell me.
